title: Graph reparametrization of a C^r chart over a linear projection (Simon Ch. 2, 4.2 and 4.4)
statement: Let P, d, r ∈ ℕ with r ≥ 1, N, W ⊆ ℝ^P, V ⊆ ℝ^d, ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P, π : ℝ^P → ℝ^d a continuous linear map, c ∈ ℝ^P and v₀ ∈ V. Suppose V and W are open, ψ is C^r on V and injective on V, ψ(V) = W ∩ N, V ∩ ψ^{-1}(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and π ∘ Dψ(v₀) is injective. Then there are open sets D ⊆ ℝ^d and O ⊆ ℝ^P and a map g : ℝ^d → ℝ^P with ψ(v₀) ∈ O ⊆ W such that g is C^r on D, g is injective on D, g(D) = O ∩ N, D ∩ g^{-1}(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ O, Dg(a) is injective for every a ∈ D, and π(g(a) − c) = a for every a ∈ D.
